info.title: Website checker (an idea we can build)
info.summary: An agent that visits your website like a customer, tries the buttons and forms, checks twice and tells you what broke and where.

direction.concept: An arcade bug hunt across a website

scenes.say: One broken button? You lose orders and never know.
scenes.title: One broken button

scenes.say: A customer taps order, nothing happens, and they quietly leave.
scenes.title: Nothing happens
items: The order button did not respond.

scenes.say: Here is an agent we can build for you. It visits your website like a customer.
scenes.title: An agent we can build

scenes.say: It opens the pages, taps the buttons, and tries your forms.
scenes.title: It tries everything

scenes.say: When something fails, it checks twice before it raises the alarm.
scenes.title: Checked twice

scenes.say: Then you get a clear note, saying what broke and where.
scenes.title: What broke, and where
items: Order page: the button does not respond.

scenes.say: Want this watching your site? Comment the words site check.
scenes.title: Comment SITE CHECK

caption:
One broken button? You lose orders and never know.

An idea we can build: an agent that clicks through your site like a customer and tells you what failed.

Comment SITE CHECK and we will send you the details.
